# Enable experimental Sequence Activity<AvailableFrom v="4.0.535" />

Discover layers in nearby hidden scenes in the Remotion Studio before they become visible. This experimental feature may use more CPU. Disabled by default. Does not affect rendering.

## CLI flag

```text
--experimental-sequence-activity
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.setExperimentalSequenceActivityEnabled(true);
```
